sections.label: Consolidating into dedicated public health agency
sections.summary: Consolidating into a dedicated agency helps build public health expertise, capacity and international linkages to tackle future pandemics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: By consolidating into a dedicated agency, it will help us systematically build up strong public health expertise and organisational capacity and establish international linkages, to better tackle future pandemics.

sections.label: CDA working with NEA on dengue
sections.summary: CDA must work seamlessly with agencies like NEA to tackle dengue, which has environmental and medical dimensions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: CDA must work seamlessly with other agencies, like the National Environment Agency (NEA) to tackle challenges like dengue, which has both environmental and medical dimensions.

sections.label: CDA preparing Singapore for Disease X
sections.summary: CDA must prepare Singapore for Disease X, an unknown pathogen with pandemic potential, by anticipating, planning and building a robust system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Most importantly, CDA must prepare Singapore to face "Disease X", a potentially unknown pathogen with pandemic potential.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Our goal should not just be to respond effectively when the time comes but to anticipate, plan, and build a robust system which mitigates the worst outcomes.

sections.label: Bill recommendation and Workers' Party support
sections.summary: The agency was a key COVID-19 White Paper recommendation alluded to by Minister Ong Ye Kung, and the Workers' Party supports the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: It was one of the key recommendations of the Government's COVID-19 White Paper and its formation was already alluded to in Health Minister Ong Ye Kung's speech during the related debate.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I do not propose to revisit the arguments that were made by the Workers' Party then but let me state at the outset that we support this present Bill.

sections.label: Dengue and H1N1 case figures
sections.summary: Dengue cases island-wide were 13,564 in 2024, and a 2009 H1N1 outbreak led to an estimated 270,000 infections and 18 deaths.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: After all, recorded dengue cases island-wide amounted to 13,564 in 2024; and in 2009, an outbreak of the H1N1 strain let to an estimated 270,000 infections and 18 deaths.

sections.label: Question on clauses 51 to 53
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether clauses 51 to 53, limiting employee transfers to MOH and HPB, should be more general.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: If the new agency will draw on expertise across the whole breadth of Government functions, should clauses 51 through 53 of the Bill, which currently limit employee transfers to only MOH and HPB, should it be more general?

sections.label: COVID-19 White Paper communication theme
sections.summary: Successful communication and coordination was, directly or indirectly, a theme for four of the seven main lessons from the COVID-19 White Paper.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: After all, successful communication and coordination was, directly or indirectly, a theme for four of the seven main lessons from the COVID-19 White Paper.

sections.label: Bill establishing CDA
sections.summary: The Bill aims to establish CDA, a centralised body coordinating infectious disease management, research, surveillance and public health education.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: The Bill aims to establish CDA, a centralised body coordinating infectious disease management, research, surveillance and public health education.

sections.label: Continuity of critical services
sections.summary: The question asks what measures the Ministry will put in place to ensure critical services continue seamlessly during this period of change.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: What measures will the Ministry put in place to ensure that critical services, such as vaccination programmes, epidemiological studies and disease monitoring, continue seamlessly during this period of change?

sections.label: CDA transparency and accountability
sections.summary: The question asks what systems will be implemented to ensure CDA operates transparently and is held accountable for its decisions and use of public funds.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: What systems will be implemented to ensure CDA operates transparently and is held accountable for its decisions and use of public funds?

sections.label: Employee career and morale concerns
sections.summary: The question asks what steps the Ministry will take to address long-term concerns around career progression, job security, work benefits and morale of these employees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Beyond the assurances provided in the Bill, what steps will the Ministry take to address long-term concerns around career progression, job security, work benefits and the morale of these employees?

sections.label: CDA harnessing MOH HPB NCID
sections.summary: CDA will harness the collective expertise of MOH, HPB and NCID, fostering closer teamwork and synergy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: CDA will harness the collective expertise of MOH, HPB and NCID, fostering closer teamwork and synergy.

sections.label: Interim CDA established 2023
sections.summary: In end 2023, the interim CDA was established as a pre-operations structure for critical functions like disease surveillance, monitoring and investigations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In end 2023, we established the interim CDA as a pre-operations structure, where critical functions, including disease surveillance, monitoring and investigations, can steadily transit and continue to operate effectively.

sections.label: CDA as WHO focal point
sections.summary: As National Focal Point for WHO's International Health Regulations, CDA will be primary contact for WHO and other countries on disease outbreak, notification and information sharing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For instance, as the National Focal Point for WHO's International Health Regulations, CDA will be the primary point of contact for WHO and other countries on disease outbreak, notification and information sharing.

sections.label: CDA accountable to Health Minister
sections.summary: As a Statutory Board under MOH, the CDA will be accountable to the Minister for Health in performing its functions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As a Statutory Board under MOH, the CDA will be accountable to the Minister for Health in the performance of its functions.

sections.label: Citation year changed to 2025
sections.summary: The citation year "2024" will be changed to "2025", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The citation year "2024" will be changed to "2025", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.
